evidence: Static source review only; the verifier image was not built or run on these bytes. tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...a55fdd) is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile; test.sh, .dockerignore, tools/ and environment/Dockerfile are also identical to the template. Each element the row requires is present: browser - tests/Dockerfile:33-39 installs Chromium with the Playwright CLI bundled in the pinned MCP package ('node "$PW_CLI" install --with-deps chromium'), so its revision is fixed by the package pin, and links it to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which is the path all five judge.toml files pass as --executable-path (e.g. scored/functional/judge.toml:11-12); Playwright - tests/Dockerfile:19 '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79', whose registry bin is 'playwright-mcp', matching the judge.toml command; judge CLI - tests/Dockerfile:17 '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281', matching REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code" (task.toml:31); RewardKit - tests/Dockerfile:31 'pip3 install --no-cache-dir harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7'; python3 for the restart server - base 'FROM python:3.12-slim' (line 2), used by scored/functional/judge.toml:17-18; app runtime - Node 22 copied from node:22-bookworm-slim (lines 1, 4), 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' (lines 20-21) with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (line 9), the same two packages and versions as environment/Dockerfile:10-11 and as promised in integration.md:5. test.sh's launch tools are covered: setpriv/setsid from util-linux and procps (tests/Dockerfile:13). The golden server needs nothing else at runtime: solution/app/server.js:2-5 requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3, and the client is shipped prebuilt (public/index.html loads /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css); the other package.json dependencies are bundled client code. task.toml:2 carries /app and /assets into the separate verifier. A read-only registry query on 2026-10-02 confirmed all five npm pins and harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 exist. Alternatives tried: a conforming app with extra pure-JS or native dependencies ships them under /app/node_modules, which test.sh:92 copies and which run on the same Node 22 major, so it is not failed by the image; this row has no weak-app path. Unmeasured: raw-evidence-index.json records scripted golden checks only and states 'The app ran as root without DB_PATH; the test.sh launch path (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH) is not measured.' No verifier image build, app launch under test.sh, or judge run exists for this input hash, so risk stays true. Base images are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned (template-controlled; unpinned apt is a NOTE per check-dockerfiles.py).
